name: com.zetph.zetsfancyshader
description: PC-only toon + PBR shader for VRChat avatars, with AudioLink-reactive emission and FX, geometry break, glitch, interior mapping, subsurface scattering, debug views, and a companion eye shader. Reads AudioLink and VRSL GI straight from the globals worlds publish - nothing to install. Optional LTCGI and VRC Light Volumes support activates automatically when those packages are present. Ships its own material inspector, locking and map packer - no ThryEditor required.
